_note: PUT this to /v2/acts/{actorId} as a pricingInfos array entry. PAY_PER_EVENT only on BRONZE. startedAt must be 14+ days out. Apify auto-adds 20% margin. iTunes Search is keyless and RSS feeds are fetched with a Range header (only the channel header), so compute per lead is tiny. High volume, low prices. First 10 qualified_lead per run are free for validation. | 2026-08-17 pass: per-run free allowance cut to 1 (0 where average output is under ~2 rows/run). It is charged per run, not per user, so on low-yield actors it was zeroing out revenue. Descriptions corrected to match src/main.js. Effective 09-01.

listing.eventDescription: One podcast with name, author, category, episode count, and last-episode date, but no public email or website.

lead.eventDescription: A show with a public host email or a website, plus category, episode count, and last-episode date.

qualified_lead.eventDescription: An active show (recent episode) with a public host email and at least 10 episodes. A reachable, established host. The first qualified lead per run is free so you can validate output.
